subject.title: fix(secrets): surface degradation in logs and doctor

question: Should the existing owner-scoped startup/reload isolation policy expose this richer degradation lifecycle through logs and doctor without a gateway protocol/status contract change?
rationale: The patch deliberately changes operator-visible handling of security-sensitive SecretRef failures across reload and rollback paths; the stated no-protocol decision needs confirmation from the owner of that boundary.

options.title: Approve the logs-and-doctor boundary
options.body: Keep the operator signal limited to redacted logs and doctor, then require final-head runtime proof before merge.

options.title: Require a broader status contract
options.body: Pause this PR and define an additive gateway/status surface if consumers need machine-readable degradation state.

options.title: Narrow to startup only
options.body: Defer reload lifecycle reporting if maintainers do not want to extend the existing startup isolation contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the logs-and-doctor boundary
recommendation.body: Keep the operator signal limited to redacted logs and doctor, then require final-head runtime proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work established the relevant owner-isolation and degraded-status foundation.
